topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 28 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 4 ERC4626 vaults, 7 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs, 2 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 9 common project-authored base contract(s) (oftupgradeable, oftcoreupgradeable, oappupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
